description: Bornes de recharge pour ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon. List of functional charging stations for electric vehicles in Chazelles-sur-Lyon. Coverage: Ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for electric vehicle city of Chazelles-sur-Lyon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon. Its keywords include bornes-de-recharge, voitures-electriques. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
